public_health_question.v: What strategies should persons and communities use to minimize medically significant COVID-19 illness, death and health care system strain?

ev.q: CDC recommends a strategic approach to minimizing the impact of COVID-19 on health and society that relies on vaccination and therapeutics
Summary of Guidance for Minimizing the Impact of COVID-19 on Individual Persons, Communities, and Health Care Systems
Continuing to increase vaccination coverage and ensuring that persons are up to date with vaccination are essential to preventing severe outcomes.
To prevent medically significant COVID-19 illness and death, persons must understand their risk
